{{Article header|deck=A field reference for Bark Mounds, including value, sampling distance, environmental profiles and known visual variants.}}

{{Exobiology species infobox}}

'''Bark Mounds''' is a pre-Odyssey surface organism protected by a dense outer layer. Maintained community models associate it with volcanism and large nebula environments outside the central galactic region.<ref name="canonn">[https://us-central1-canonn-api-236217.cloudfunctions.net/query/codex/ref Canonn Codex reference], snapshot retrieved 28 September 2026.</ref>

== Identification ==

Look for compact, bark-textured mounds rather than tall individual stems. The Codex does not distinguish separate colour variants for this organism.
